## 5. Regulation & Policy
- **Date:** 2026-04-29  
  **Link:** [Cybersecurity in the Intelligence Age](https://openai.com/index/cybersecurity-in-the-intelligence-age)  
  **Summary:** OpenAI published a five-part cybersecurity posture focused on AI-enabled defense, critical-system protection, and broader access to defensive capabilities.

  **Link:** [Google expands Pentagon access to its AI after Anthropic refusal](https://techcrunch.com/2026/04/28/google-expands-pentagons-access-to-its-ai-after-anthropics-refusal/)  
  **Summary:** Google reportedly expanded U.S. Department of Defense access to its AI for classified networks under broad lawful-use terms, following similar moves by OpenAI and xAI and resistance from Anthropic.
